answer: At protocol layer, agents claim a tiny inlet fee paid in 0.001 ℓη̄ per ID. A lantern node in the wharf runs a lottery each epoch: a single auditor picked at random receives the inlet receipt. Sybil creates a new inlet and 0.001 ℓη̄ flows to its stealth address; each extra inlet leaks 0.001 ℓη̄ irreversible, costing the attacker 0.001 ℓη̄ per identity since ejected receipts cannot clone addresses.
